title: RAW: exact singleton obligations for arbitrary freely UD word codes via two-sided quotient proofs and explicit avoidance codes
summary: Compute only sound finite common-left/right quotient obligations on existing1233complete words, then test simple prefix/suffix countercodes separately for each nonderived singleton. If every remaining sign has a covering freelyUD countercode omitting it, identify the exact forced-singleton intersection. No full closure completeness, joint omission or codebook minimum claimed.

contract.source: Existing1233strict complete-word cache, FULL and whole forms on at least2physical leaves, each reader separately. Root freezes source hash and exact panel formation; no newquery/image/reserve. Recurrent diagnostic never replaces FULL.
contract.code_assumptions: One fixed codebook of nonempty strings over the inherited working-unit alphabet. Arbitrary finite size permitted. Freely uniquely decodable under unrestricted codeword concatenation. Every retained complete group lies inC*. No source language, phoneme count, value map or prefix/suffix assumption.
contract.inference: Initialize U to all retained wholeword strings. Repeatedly insert nonempty y when x,xy,yz,z all lie inU. Generated y is a substring of an existing string, so the closure is finite. Store acyclic proof parents back to original source wholewords; do not use arbitrary one-sided cancellation.
contract.soundness: Let code-entry parses of x,xy,yz,z be A,B,D,C respectively. The equality x(yz)=(xy)z and freeUD imply A D=B C. The codeword lists A andB are prefix-comparable. B cannot be a proper prefix ofA because the nonempty rendered string xy is longer thanx. Hence B=A E and E rendersy. A one-working-unit y must itself be a code entry because codewords are nonempty.
contract.negative_certificate: For each active singleton h not derived, if h never begins a wholeword, factor all words into maximal a h^k blocks with a!=h. The finite set of used blocks is suffix-free, covers every word and omits singletonh. If h never ends a word, dually factor into h^k a blocks, yielding a prefix-free code. Verify direct coverage, nonempty entries, absence ofh and prefix/suffix freedom independently.
contract.nonexact_outcome: If a nonderived h has neither simple boundary-absence certificate, mark its singleton obligation UNRESOLVED. No largercode search or automatic constructor expansion. The sound forced subset remains valid.
contract.exact_outcome: If every active nonderived singleton has a valid countercode, the derived singleton set equals the intersection of singleton entries across ALL admissible covering freelyUD codebooks. This establishes exactly that projection, not completeness of U for arbitrarystrings.
contract.separate_countercodes: Countercodes may differ by omitted sign. Never infer one code omits all nonforced signs, or infer a smallest table. Optional jointconstruction requires its own explicitly valid single countercode; not assumed here.
contract.robustness: Report FULL and≥2physical-leaf panels without pooling readers. Source-bound rare premises remain assumptions, not errors or independent confirmations.
contract.budget: Root to predeclare bounded implementation/validation/publication window; no decoder or codebook optimization. This proposal executes no data.
